subject: HIPAA gateway packaging: activation fees vs recurring gateway billing
messages:

Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HIPAA gateway packaging question and onboarding fees

Hi Ben / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the low-latency routing and audit log options look promising for our use case. Procurement here; a couple things we need clarified before we loop in legal:

1) We see separate line items for an "activation / onboarding" fee and for recurring "HIPAA gateway" licensing (audit logs + KMS + residency). Can you explain what is typically covered by the onboarding charge vs what we should expect on a monthly recurring invoice?

2) HealthScale is trying to decide whether to have a one-time capital-style activation for residency and HSM seats (to amortize) or treat everything as recurring OPEX. Which packaging points reduce our overall three-year TCO?

3) For HSM seats we have a short pilot (3 months). Can you provide options (a) pro-rated activation + monthly in pilot, (b) delayed activation invoice until production, or (c) fully recurring with a volume discount?

We'd appreciate a concise breakdown and an example invoice for year 1 vs year 3. Attached is our security scope doc for reference.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Senior Procurement Manager
HealthScale

Attachment: healthscale-security-scope.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: HIPAA gateway packaging question and onboarding fees

Emma — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up top, details below:

TL;DR: Activation covers one-time setup and evidence delivery (onboarding, HSM provisioning, audit log baseline ingestion), recurring covers ongoing custody (HSM seat maintenance), retention, and SLA-backed storage/ingest. For pilots we usually offer pro-rated activation or delay invoicing until production; we can also provide a blended annual discount if you commit to 12+ months.

Details:
- Activation / Onboarding (one-time): project management, HSM key provisioning and attestation, initial audit log retention backfill (up to X GB), compliance attestations (SOC2/HIPAA deliverables) and runbook handover. Typically invoiced up-front or net-30.
- Recurring (monthly): HSM seat maintenance, encrypted key storage, continuous audit-log retention (tiered), gateway/ingest throughput SLA, and ongoing compliance monitoring. This is the recurring OPEX.
- Pricing levers that reduce 3yr TCO: (1) amortize activation across a 36-month contract (we convert onboarding into a monthly line item), (2) commit to throughput tiers (volume discount), (3) accept a higher retention tier only where required.

Pilot options we can offer for HealthScale:
A) Pro-rated activation (pay a 25% activation during pilot, remainder at production go-live).
B) Zero activation during pilot, pay full activation at production (we push all evidence delivery to go-live milestone).
C) No activation; full recurring setup with 10% pilot discount on monthly until production + option to credit activation against year-1 invoices.

I'll loop Laura to propose numbers and a short sample invoice. If you want an amortized schedule for accounting, we can show a 3-year P&L comparison.

Best,

Emma — attaching a short SOW + two invoice scenarios: (1) Activation up-front + monthly recurring; (2) Activation amortized across 36 months as a monthly line item. I included an example where activation is credited if you sign a 12-month commitment.

Key callouts:
- HSM seats: priced per-seat + per-hour for dedicated residency hosts. If you choose shared HSM (multi-tenant), seat price drops ~40% but we provide attestation rather than dedicated key custody.
- Audit logs: base retention 90 days included; 1 year and 3 year tiers are additional. Longer retention is the main driver of storage costs.
- Evidence delivery (SOC2/HIPAA): one-off included in activation; ongoing periodic attestations are part of premium support (separate add-on).

See attached: SOW-draft-HealthScale.docx and hipaa-scope.pdf (redacted). Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the invoice numbers. Tessa — can you confirm implementation lead time assumptions (pilot -> prod)?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-draft-HealthScale.docx, hipaa-scope.pdf

Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HIPAA gateway packaging question and onboarding fees

Emma — implementation timing: pilot 3-6 weeks (environment + HSM provisioning) if we use shared HSM and no backfill. If you require dedicated residency/HSM provisioning and audit-log backfill we assume 6-10 weeks. For option A (pro-rated activation) we need a signed pilot SOW; for option B we can do an MSA + pilot statement with delayed activation invoicing.

If HealthScale wants a clean accounting treatment, amortizing activation over 36 months is the most straightforward for finance teams. I'll mark the action items we need from your side:
- PO or signed pilot SOW
- Required retention window (90d/1yr/3yr)
- Dedicated HSM required? (yes/no)

Happy to take a call to align next steps.

—Tessa

- HealthScale prefers amortized activation across 36 months for CAPEX/OPs planning.
- Pilot: shared HSM is fine for now; we will request dedicated HSM at production if throughput requires it.
- Retention: start with 1 year, option to increase to 3 years after Q2 2029.

Next steps: we'll get a PO over for the pilot SOW (pro-rated activation per option A) by next Wed. Please include the sample invoice for year 1 (amortized activation) and a straight-up front activation invoice in the SOW pack so finance can compare.
